title: Rough copper WR-90, 200 mm, 1 µm rms: TE10 attenuation by the walls at 10 GHz
source: TE10 conductor attenuation α_c = R_s(2bπ² + a³k²)/(a³bβkη) (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, eq. 3.96), R_s = √(ωμ0/2σ), σ = 5.8e7 S/m, times the Hammerstad–Jensen roughness factor K = 1 + (2/π) arctan(1.4 (Δ/δ)²) (E. Hammerstad and Ø. Jensen, IEEE MTT-S Digest 1980, pp. 407–409), Δ = 1 µm, δ = 0.661 µm: K = 1.80750, α = 0.022554 Np/m, evaluated separately from EMCraft's code

quantities.quantity: |S21| at 10 GHz (dB): the loss of 200 mm of rough copper guide
quantities.reason: the smooth case's band (wall-loss: the Leontovich condition with second-order elements of 4 mm, within 0.2 %): the rough walls' impedance is the smooth one times K, which the loss follows to first order in R_s/η
the lossy guide's TE10 differs from the lossless port mode by order K R_s/η
